title: Fair Recipes Plus
description: Fair Recipes Plus is a gameplay-focused Minecraft mod that rebalances crafting and improves consistency across many core systems.
body:
Fair Recipes is a gameplay-focused Minecraft mod that rebalances crafting and improves consistency across many core systems.

The goal is simple: make recipes more logical, more efficient, and more rewarding—without breaking vanilla gameplay.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔧 FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧱 Suspicious Sand & Gravel Crafting
- Craft suspicious sand and gravel using 8 blocks + any item in the center
- The inserted item is stored and will be returned when brushed
- Empty variants can be crafted for decoration

⚒️ Netherite Upgrade Improvements
- Upgrade diamond tools and armor directly while preserving enchantments
- Removes unnecessary friction from late-game progression
- Netherite Upgrade smithing template can be crafted more simply than the duplication recipe, however it requires visiting the nether and a bastion to get gilded blackstone and netherrack.

🛏️ Stackable Beds
- Beds now stack up to 16 for improved inventory management
- Bed recipe gives 2 beds

🗺️ Map System Overhaul
- Craft maps using:
  - Feather + Ink Sac + Paper + Compass
- Expand maps using:
  - Filled Map + Paper
- Multiple paper increases map size in a single craft (up to 4x scale)
- No unnecessary crafting steps or cartography table required

📦 Recipe Rebalancing
- Adjusted outputs for various recipes (e.g. panes, walls, bookshelves)
- Improved material efficiency across multiple crafting chains

🧵 Crafting Consistency Improvements
- Leather and rabbit hide unified via shared crafting logic
- Various recipes adjusted for better balance and usability

🖼️ Images
- All recipes or changes are detailed in attached image gallery

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎯 DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Fair Recipes aims to:
- Reduce unnecessary grind
- Improve logical consistency
- Respect vanilla mechanics while enhancing usability
- Keep gameplay balanced but less frustrating

This is not a “cheat mod”—it’s a refinement mod.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ COMPATIBILITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Works on both client and server, but is not required on the client if used on a server
- Requires Fabric API
- Designed for Minecraft 1.21.11

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
